titleDv: ޤާނޫނު ނަންބަރު 30/2015 (ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ކުޅިވަރު ޤާނޫނު) އަށް ... ވަނަ އިޞްލާޙު ގެނައުމުގެ ބިލު
summary: This bill amends the Maldives Sports Act (Law No. 30/2015). It changes Articles 1 to 6 and adds new Articles 4-1 and 5-1. It adds numbered lists of kinds of sports bodies and participants, and new provisions about registering clubs, associations or federations that refer to the Associations Act (Law No. 3/2022). This summary covers the first 12 of 80 pages, and the scans are hard to read, so some details are uncertain.
whyItMatters: Sports clubs, associations and the people who run or play in them could face new registration and recognition rules under the Act.
keyProvisions: Clause 1 amends Article 1(b), and Clauses 2 to 6 amend paragraphs of Article 2.
Clause 7 amends Article 3 with a longer list of persons or things the Act covers.
Clause 8 amends Article 4(a) to list two categories, and Clause 9 adds Article 4-1 with a numbered list of up to 13 kinds of sports body or participant.
Clauses 9 and 10 refer to registration of sports bodies under the Associations Act (Law No. 3/2022), with separate paragraphs for different kinds of body.
Clause 10 amends Article 5, and Clause 11 adds Article 5-1 with several paragraphs on recognition or registration.
Clauses 12 to 14 amend Article 6(a), (b) and (c). The rest of the bill, pages 13 to 80, was not rendered.
whoIsAffected: Sports clubs, associations and federations, and their officials, members and players.
